findingDetails.title: The hand-over part runs on every tool call with no size gate, so the journal is re-parsed each time
The session-start composer has no CLI-entry guard and no test, unlike the other three composers
The turn-start composer uses the raw payload cwd as the project root while the guard seam resolves it against the checkout

results.notes: The documented part order matches the code. The compaction binding's documented size gate holds for the compaction part only, not for the hand-over part beside it.
No checklist document on a hook and plugin surface.

noveltyJustification: All three findings are new. R3-P2-001 is a different cost from the prior round's deferred R3-P2-003: a different file, a different mechanism, and the reader is named. R3-P2-002 and R3-P2-003 have no prior counterpart.
ruledOut: Journal segment ordering in the session reader: zero-padded names make the lexicographic sort correct
compaction-post-tool judging a non-post_tool payload: buildPostToolPart checks hook_event_name itself
turn-end requiring the completion part by an absolute path: createRequire accepts an absolute path and the path resolves correctly
A wrong relative root in any composer: each climbs the correct number of levels to the checkout
